title: Free Health Camp
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Elegant organised a Free Health Camp on 16th October 2026 at P2 Banquet Hall, Raheja Imperia-01, Lower Parel, with the support of RBL Bank’s CSR initiative, facilitated by PP Nilimma Jhunjhunwala.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Elegant organised a Free Health Camp on 16th October 2026 at P2 Banquet Hall, Raheja Imperia-01, Lower Parel, with the support of RBL Bank’s CSR initiative, facilitated by PP Nilimma Jhunjhunwala. The camp benefited drivers, domestic helpers, security guards, housekeeping staff and other support workers. Free eye check-ups, spectacles for those in need and basic blood tests were provided. The initiative reflected Rotary’s commitment to promoting healthcare and improving the well-being of underserved communities.
